senses.gloss: m. (נָסַע) = preced. w., (with or sub. הַדַּעַת) discarding, giving up.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 1:8:9">Y. Pes. I, 28ᵇ</cite> top <he>ה׳ דבר תורה</he>, v. <cite ref="E00470"><he>הֶיסֵּחַ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 7:2:3">Y. Shek. VII, beg. 50ᶜ</cite> <he>ה׳ דעת טעון וכ׳</he> sacrificial meat whose existence has been forgotten (is unfit and) requires decomposition before it is burnt.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:8:2">Y. Meg. IV, 75ᶜ</cite> top <he>מפני ה׳ ד׳</he> because his attention may be diverted (by looking at the priests); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:1:4">Y. Taan. IV, beg. 67ᵇ</cite> <cite ref="M01925"><he>מסיע</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 10:7:2">Y. Pes. X, 37ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>מפני ה׳ הד׳</he> because the thought of eating it has been abandonned.
